name: Che me den
summary: A black-sesame chè, one of the two sweets of Hoa family and community life in Tây Ninh, with sâm bổ lượng.
origin: Hoa kitchens in Tây Ninh. The cooking is Teochew and Cantonese in origin, adapted to local ingredients.
howToEat: Finish a Hoa meal with it, or with sâm bổ lượng.
seoTitle: Che me den in Tay Ninh
seoDescription: Chè mè đen, the black-sesame sweet of Tây Ninh’s Hoa families.
